## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.

Users have reported issues with the integration not polling on init and restart. This was originally done by design to preserve battery, but the discussion has led to a decision to introduce polling on init/restart after all. This is also more consistent with generally expected HA-behavior. This is therefore seen as a bug fix.
For fixing this, some code improvements have had to te be made, based on suggestions in previous PR-reviews.

Poking around a bit, the config entry in `/config/.storage/core.config_entries` looks like this: ```yaml { "entry_id": "8eaaa3d239b6f015491de7c513a74c6d", "version": 2, "domain": "landisgyr_heat_meter", "title": "LUGCUH50", "data": { "device": "/dev/serial/by-id/usb-Silicon_Labs_CP2102_USB_to_UART_Bridge_Controller_0001-if00-port0", "model": "LUGCUH50", "device_number": "66209936" }, "options": {}, "pref_disable_new_entities": false, "pref_disable_polling": false, "source": "user", "unique_id": "66209936", "disabled_by": null } ``` which shows that it did manage to read the model and device number. I do see the right model number in the Device Info panel, but all other values are marked as _unknown_:

Hi @wichert, could you try to call the homeassistant.update_entity service and update on of the heat meter entities (any will do)?

If you're familiar with yaml:
```
service: homeassistant.update_entity
data: {}
target:
  entity_id: sensor.heat_meter_heat_usage_gj

```

If this works, it hasn't polled yet. By default it (only) polls once every 24 hours, to save battery. If your unit is on mains, you can make an automation that does the polling more frequently.

Hope this helps. Let me know if it does.

This behavior will change with https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/80346, which will add polling on restart 
I'm also working on a battery/mains option for more frequent default polling
That seems to have done something useful. I did setup the integration yesterday, so I was expecting it to have polled by this afternoon which apparently did not happen.
